title: Create: Master Engineer
body:
## 📖 Overview


```
🚀 Design, automate, and scale massive industrial systems with the ultimate Create experience.
```

**Create: Master Engineer** is a tech-focused modpack built around the full potential of Create and its addon ecosystem.

Expand your mechanical empire with automation, factories, transport systems, and production chains. Includes 30+ Create addons, expanded automation systems, and deep production chains., building & decoration mods, farming integration, and performance optimizations.

Designed for players who love complex systems, creative engineering, and immersive industrial builds.

**💡 From simple machines to massive industrial systems — everything is possible.**

![Wheat Farm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12754d43021f4be6d8ef546a8a930c69cf7a58e3.png)

## ⚙️ Key Features:

- 🏭 Advanced machinery & automation
- 🔗 Factory and production chain expansion
- 🚂 Transportation & logistics systems
- 🌾 Farming & food integration
- 🏗️ Building & decoration mods
- ⚡ Optimized performance & QoL

![Gravel Farm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0428eaf7aa08e80ec135afbc194d50e76355f52.png)

## 🎯 Gameplay Focus

- 🏭 Industrial engineering
- ⚙️ Automation & machinery
- 🚂 Logistics & transport systems
- 🌾 Food production chains
- 🏗️ Creative factory design

![Coffee Factory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e3770766647e09d8b95fe100a298e99e0022bec.png)

## ⭐ Why this modpack?

- 🔧 35+ Create addons for unmatched automation depth
- ⚡ Carefully optimized for best performance
- 🏭 Focused tech experience – no unnecessary clutter
- 🎮 Built for long-term progression and large-scale factories

![Working Trains](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d7bcf42644c52eab0a7b0d3f3b346d54a827169.png)
